statements.description: IMAP4rev2 implementations MAY transmit 8-bit or multi-octet characters in literals but SHOULD do so only when the [CHARSET] is identified.

statements.description: IMAP4rev2 implementations MUST accept and MAY transmit [UTF-8] text in quoted-strings as long as the string does not contain NUL, CR, or LF.
statements.pre_cond: quoted_string.contains_NUL = false & quoted_string.contains_CR = false & quoted_string.contains_LF = false

statements.description: A string with an excessive amount of CTL characters MAY also be considered to be binary.

statements.subject: participant
statements.description: Unless returned in response to BINARY.PEEK[...]/BINARY[...] FETCH, client and server implementations MUST encode binary data into a textual form, such as base64, before transmitting the data.
actions: encode binary data into a textual form such as base64 before transmitting
